hero.title: About Moment Art
hero.subtitle: We're passionate about bringing you the latest in beauty trends, expert tips, and creative inspiration. Our mission is to empower everyone to express their unique beauty through art and innovation.

story.title: Our Story
story.content: Founded in 2020, Moment Art began as a small blog sharing beauty tips and creative inspiration. What started as a passion project has grown into a comprehensive platform serving thousands of beauty enthusiasts worldwide.

mission.title: About us
mission.content: We believe that beauty is an art form, and everyone deserves access to quality information, tutorials, and inspiration to express their creativity. From nail art to wellness routines, we cover it all with authenticity and expertise.

creativity.title: Innovation
creativity.description: We stay ahead of beauty trends and bring you the latest innovations in the industry.

community.title: Community
community.description: Building a supportive community where everyone can learn and grow together.

quality.title: Authenticity
quality.description: We believe in honest reviews and genuine recommendations from real beauty experts.

excellence.title: Excellence
excellence.description: We strive for excellence in everything we do, from content quality to user experience.

artist.name: Natalia
artist.bio: Passionate about beauty innovation and licensed cosmetologist-aesthetician specializing in nail art and wellness.

developer.name: Dmitrii
developer.bio: Creating inspiring application that empowers beauty enthusiasts worldwide.

cta.title: Join Our Community
cta.description: Ready to explore the world of beauty and creativity? Join thousands of others who trust Moment Art for their daily dose of inspiration.

hero.title: Get in Touch
hero.subtitle: Have questions, suggestions, or just want to say hello? We'd love to hear from you. Reach out and let's start a conversation about beauty, creativity, and inspiration.

form.title: Send us a Message
form.name: Your Name
form.subject: Subject
form.successMessage: Thank you for contacting us. We'll get back to you soon.

info.title: Contact Information
info.addressDescription: Come say hello at our office

response.question: How quickly do you respond to messages?
response.answer: We typically respond within 24 hours during business days. For urgent matters, please call us directly.

consultation.question: Do you offer beauty consultations?
consultation.answer: Yes! We offer virtual beauty consultations. Contact us to schedule an appointment with our experts.

contribute.question: Can I contribute content to your blog?
contribute.answer: We welcome guest contributors! Send us your ideas and writing samples for review.

advertise.question: How can I advertise with you?
advertise.answer: We offer various advertising opportunities. Contact our team to discuss partnership options.
